Highlights & recommendations

🏆 Highlights

  • Lead volume up 12.8% to 2,946, outpacing the 9.5% rise in visits.
  • Email is the most efficient channel: 4.10% conversion and $2.99 per lead.
  • Paid Search delivered 39% of all leads at a $31.30 cost per lead.
  • Blended cost per lead fell 9.4% to $20.88.

⚠️ Watch-outs

  • Paid Social cost per lead is $47.65, roughly 2.3× the blended average, on 36% of spend.
  • Affiliate converts at 2.62%, the lowest of the paid channels.

🎯 Recommendations for November

  • Reallocate 15–20% of Paid Social budget to Paid Search, which has a lower cost per lead.
  • Scale Email: expand list growth and nurture sequences, since it has the lowest cost per lead.
  • Review Affiliate partners and cut those with conversion below 2.5%.
  • Invest in SEO content for Organic Search, which drives 22% of leads with no media spend.
  • Test a conversion-rate lift on landing pages for Direct and Referral traffic (2.93%).
